channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Panera Bread: Buy One Entree, Get a Second for $5
item.guid: Panera Bread-Buy One Entree, Get a Second for $5-2026-08-04
item.description: Use code BOGO5 at online or app checkout to get a second entree for just $5 with the purchase of any full-price entree at participating locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera Bread: Any Cup of Soup for $1
item.guid: Panera Bread-Any Cup of Soup for $1-2026-08-04
item.description: Use code SOUP at online or app checkout to get any cup of soup for just $1 on your order at participating Panera Bread locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Taco Bell: $1 Meximelt - Today Only (Aug 4)
item.description: Get a Meximelt for $1 via the Taco Bell app at participating locations today, August 4, 2026, from 8 AM to 11:59 PM PT. (August 4, 2026)

item.title: Krispy Kreme: 24-Count Doughnut Dots for $5 with Code DOTS
item.guid: Krispy Kreme-24-Count Doughnut Dots for $5 with Code -2026-08-04
item.description: Use promo code DOTS at online or in-app checkout to get a 24-count Original Glazed Doughnut Dots for $5 with any purchase of $5 or more; limit one per order. (Limited time)

item.title: Del Taco: $1 Value Menu - Over 10 Items
item.guid: Del Taco-$1 Value Menu - Over 10 Items-2026-08-04
item.description: Del Taco's everyday $1 value menu includes Value Bean and Cheese Burritos and other items, no app or code required. (Ongoing)

item.title: McDonald's: Daily App Deals Including $6 Combo Meals
item.guid: McDonald's-Daily App Deals Including $6 Combo Meals-2026-08-04
item.description: Open the McDonald's app daily for rotating coupons including $6 Extra Value Meals and discounts on core items like the Quarter Pounder; deals vary by day. (Ongoing)

item.title: Church's Chicken: $5.99 Smokehouse Chicken
item.description: Get the juicy marinated Smokehouse Chicken half-chicken fried without batter in your choice of five dry rub flavors for $5.99, or as a combo for about $11, at participating locations. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: KFC: Taste of KFC 2-Piece Meal for $5.99
item.description: Get a 2-piece Taste of KFC meal at participating locations for $5.99 when you order online or via the KFC app. (Ongoing)

item.title: Papa John's: 50% Off Any Pizza for Carryout Online
item.guid: Papa John's-50% Off Any Pizza for Carryout Online-2026-08-04
item.description: Order carryout online at Papa John's and get 50% off the regular menu price of any pizza; no code needed, discount applied at checkout. (Ongoing)

item.title: Arby's: $7.99 Meat and 3 Box
item.description: Get a Roast Beef or Crispy Chicken Sandwich plus three sides and a small drink for $7.99 via the Arby's app or online at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sonic: $1.99 Everyday Value Menu
item.description: Sonic's $1.99 daily menu includes items like a Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger and a Chicken Wrap available every day with no app required at participating Drive-In locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wendy's: $2 Off Breakfast Combo via App
item.guid: Wendy's-$2 Off Breakfast Combo via App-2026-08-04
item.description: Check the Wendy's app for current rotating coupons including $2 off a Breakfast Combo at participating locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)
